Now I have everything verified. Here are the compiled answers:

---

**h01.** `s3presign.Runner` — every 12 hours (`server/runner/s3presign/runner.go:27`) with an immediate run at startup — wired at `server/server.go:129` (call to `startBackgroundRunners`, runner created/launched at lines 162–171)

**h02.** Delivery function — `webhook.Post` at `internal/webhook/webhook.go:120`; Protection mechanism — `safeDialContext` (runtime DNS-resolution check against reserved CIDRs) at `internal/webhook/webhook.go:59`, plus `ValidateURL` (registration-time check) at `internal/webhook/validate.go:62`

**h03.** Abstraction package: `internal/idp` (`internal/idp/idp.go`); Implementation package: `internal/idp/oauth2` (`internal/idp/oauth2/oauth2.go`)

**h04.** No; `mysql.NewDB()` is called only inside the driver-selection factory `NewDBDriver` at `store/db/db.go:22`. A grep for `mysql.NewDB` across all non-test `.go` files confirms no other call site. The only other `mysql.` references outside the package are `testcontainers-go/modules/mysql` in `store/test/containers.go`, which is test infrastructure, not the memos MySQL driver.

**h05.** Mechanism: explicit Go code (two DELETE statements inside a transaction). Evidence:
- `deleteReactionsByContentIDsTx` removes reactions on the user's memos — `store/db/sqlite/user_delete.go:380`, `store/db/mysql/user_delete.go:417`, `store/db/postgres/user_delete.go:380`
- `deleteReactionsByCreatorTx` removes the user's own reactions — `store/db/sqlite/user_delete.go:400`, `store/db/mysql/user_delete.go:437`, `store/db/postgres/user_delete.go:400`
- Both called from `deleteUserTargetsTx` at `store/db/sqlite/user_delete.go:96–104`
- No ON DELETE CASCADE on the `reaction` table in any `LATEST.sql` migration file.

**h06.** Handlers: `CreateMemo` (`server/router/api/v1/memo_service.go:70`), `UpdateMemo` (`memo_service.go:401`), `DeleteMemo` (`memo_service.go:518`), `CreateMemoComment` (`memo_service_comments.go:20`), `SetMemoAttachments` (`memo_attachment_service.go:16`), `SetMemoRelations` (`memo_relation_service.go:16`); Convergence function: `webhook.Post` — `internal/webhook/webhook.go:120`

**h07.**
- `FileServerService.serveUserAvatar` — `server/router/fileserver/fileserver.go:168`
- `FileServerService.getUserByUsername` — `server/router/fileserver/fileserver.go:715`
- `Store.GetUser` — `store/user.go:148`
- `Store.ListUsers` — `store/user.go:136`
- `sqlite.DB.ListUsers` — `store/db/sqlite/user.go:88` (reads `avatar_url` column)
- `parseDataURI` — `server/router/fileserver/fileserver.go:737` (decodes base64 data URI to bytes, served via `c.Blob`)

**h08.**
- `s3presign.Runner` (`server/runner/s3presign/runner.go:43`) — invoked? Yes — callers: `Server.startBackgroundRunners` (`server/server.go:163`) and self-call in `Runner.Run` (`server/runner/s3presign/runner.go:36`)
- `memopayload.Runner` (`server/runner/memopayload/runner.go:27`) — invoked? No — not called from any production code

**h09.** Count: 6 distinct `Close()` declarations in non-test backend code. All 6 are invoked from production code:
- `Store.Close` — called by `Server.Shutdown` (`server/server.go:146`)
- `SSEHub.Close` — called by `Server.closeLongLivedConnections` (`server/server.go:206`)
- `Cache.Close` — called by `Store.Close` (`store/store.go:74–76`, three instances)
- `sqlite.DB.Close` / `postgres.DB.Close` / `mysql.DB.Close` — called via `s.driver.Close()` in `Store.Close` (`store/store.go:78`)

**h10.** `SortVersion.Len` — `internal/version/version.go:44` — ~179 callers (inflated by interface-dispatch resolution of `sort.Interface`). The highest non-interface-artifact fan-in is `filter.CompileToStatement` — `internal/filter/engine.go` — ~34 callers.

**h11.** 1st: `User` (~7 packages); 2nd: `Memo` (~7 packages, slightly fewer for the core struct alone). Both are well ahead of the third-place `Attachment` (~5 packages).

**h12.** Concrete method: `sqlite.DB.CreateMemo` — `store/db/sqlite/memo.go:16`. Determination: (1) `cmd/memos/main.go:122` sets `viper.SetDefault("driver", "sqlite")`; (2) `store/db/db.go:19–20` dispatches `"sqlite"` to `sqlite.NewDB`; (3) `Store.CreateMemo` (`store/memo.go:109`) delegates to `s.driver.CreateMemo`, which resolves to the SQLite implementation.

**h13.** Impl: `markdown.service` (unexported, `internal/markdown/markdown.go:58`). Construction: `markdown.NewService` (`internal/markdown/markdown.go:85`), called in `NewAPIV1Service` (`server/router/api/v1/v1.go:48`). Holders: `APIV1Service` (`server/router/api/v1/v1.go:35`), `memopayload.Runner` (`server/runner/memopayload/runner.go:16`), `RSSService` (`server/router/rss/rss.go:45`)

**h14.** Computation site: `memopayload.RebuildMemoPayload` (`server/runner/memopayload/runner.go:74`), which calls `markdownService.ExtractAll()`. Triggers: `CreateMemo` (`memo_service.go:108`), `UpdateMemo` when content changes (`memo_service.go:447`), `Runner.RunOnce` batch rebuild (`runner.go:52`). Extracted properties: `has_link`, `has_task_list`, `has_code`, `has_incomplete_tasks`, `title`, and `tags`.

**h15.**
- `checkMemoReadAccess` — `server/router/api/v1/memo_service.go:39`
- `ListMemos` visibility filtering — `server/router/api/v1/memo_service.go:218`
- `ListMemoReactions` check — `server/router/api/v1/reaction_service.go:30`
- `UpsertMemoReaction` check — `server/router/api/v1/reaction_service.go:83`
- `ListMemoAttachments` check — `server/router/api/v1/memo_attachment_service.go:214`
- `checkAttachmentAccess` — `server/router/api/v1/attachment_service.go:422`
- `CreateMemoComment` check — `server/router/api/v1/memo_service_comments.go:41`
- `SSEHub.canReceive` — `server/router/api/v1/sse_hub.go:134`
- File server attachment access — `server/router/fileserver/fileserver.go:677`
- RSS feed (Public only) — `server/router/rss/rss.go:90,141`
- Frontend sitemap (Public only) — `server/router/frontend/frontend.go:150`
- User stats visibility filter — `server/router/api/v1/user_service_stats.go:84`
- Notification `canViewerAccessMemo` — `server/router/api/v1/user_service_notifications.go:302`
- Mention context check — `server/router/api/v1/memo_mention_helpers.go:56`

**r01.** Premise is wrong: there is no Redis anywhere in the codebase (no Redis dependency in `go.mod`, zero grep hits). The cache is a pure in-memory implementation using `sync.Map`, defined in `store/cache/cache.go`. User entries have a 10-minute TTL, set at `store/store.go:41`.

**r02.** Premise is wrong: there is no per-user API rate-limiting middleware. No rate-limiting package is imported. The API layer uses Connect interceptors (`server/router/api/v1/connect_interceptors.go`) for authentication but not rate limiting.

**r03.** Premise is wrong: there is no nightly database-cleanup cron job. The `internal/scheduler` package exists as a general-purpose library but is not used by the application server. The only recurring background task is the S3 presign runner (every 12 hours via `time.Ticker`).

**r04.** Premise is wrong: neither NATS nor RabbitMQ is used. Webhook delivery uses a plain Go buffered channel (`make(chan *WebhookRequestPayload, 128)`) declared at `internal/webhook/webhook.go:39`, consumed by 4 goroutines started in `init()` at line 42, which call `Post()` to deliver via direct HTTP.

**r05.** Premise is wrong: there is no GraphQL API. The public API is defined using Protocol Buffers (gRPC) + ConnectRPC. Protobuf service definitions are in `proto/api/v1/*.proto`, Go implementations in `server/router/api/v1/`, and all services are registered via `ConnectServiceHandler` in `server/router/api/v1/connect_handler.go:31–49`.
